query_lines: -- Alert: gold.fact_picklists violations (Integrity and Null SKs)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM logiflow.gold.fact_picklists
WHERE fk_empresa_sk IS NULL OR fk_cliente_sk IS NULL OR fk_data_sk IS NULL
-- Testa integridade e versionamento do hash
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM logiflow.gold.fact_picklists WHERE row_hash IS NULL
-- Testa SLA inválido (tempos negativos de execução)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM logiflow.gold.fact_picklists WHERE sla_segundos < 0
